reviews.reason: Adding up the individual line items in the hospital bill correctly results in the subtotal of 59916.34 and adding the 5% tax of 2995.82 gives the total payable of 62912.16.
The sum of the hospital total payable (62912.16) and the pharmacy bill (552.00) equals 63464.16, which exactly matches the amount claimed.
The pharmacy bill is from Noida while the hospital and inpatient stay occurred in Chennai, meaning these outside medicines could not have been legitimately used for this hospital admission.
The dates match correctly, but the geographic discrepancy indicates a real problem with the validity of the pharmacy bill.
